name: strata-copilot-chat
description: Strata for Copilot Chat: run Strata local OpenAI-compatible models in GitHub Copilot Chat like LM Studio. Text, tool calls, images, auto-detected limits. Built using the LM Studio provider extension. Known issue: closing Strata can hide the provider until the Strata integration is re-enabled or models refreshed.

strata.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Strata OpenAI-compatible API (the 'API base URL' shown in the Strata app).

strata.apiKey.description: Optional API key. Leave empty when Strata has no key configured.

strata.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens Strata may generate per reply. 0 detects the limit from Strata; a positive value overrides it.

strata.contextWindow.description: Context window (in tokens) reported to Copilot Chat for Strata models. 0 detects the window from Strata; a positive value overrides it.
